title: Need more customization
body: I use this app with Apple Watch and it’s pretty nice. Yet the app only tracks my sleep from night to dawn, scores my sleep quite low with “not getting enough sleep”. The problem here is that I am accustomed to midday sleep (longer than a nap but shorter than night sleep), which divides my total sleep time into two sessions. I hope this app can calculate midday sleep. Thankyou.

title: Ok but it could be more
body:
I was looking for options to log or enter my medical test and lab results so that I could see in a chart if there’s any progress after some months or years of doing the recommended exercises, diet, and lifestyle changes. Anyway, I hope it is in the pipeline.
